about_the_game:
Boiiing Boiiing is a physics-based party game up to 4 players in local. In this game of tag, you bounce with a pogo stick that you angle in order to catch or to escape your opponent. The plot twist? You can play as differents animals with their own unique powers!

Bounce around with your pogo stick in a bunch of differents maps. Catch your friends as the chaser, or escape them until the timer runs out. Exactly like a game of tag, the most exciting game of your childhood.

Play with your friends and family in three differents games modes: 1v1, 2v2, FFA. No friends? No problem! Play with bots and practice in the training campus.
Wanna play with your grandma? No problem! Boiiing Boiiing is accessible with just 3 buttons, and a different control mode for begginers! Two players can even play on the same keyboard!

The PLOT TWIST of Boiiing Boiiing! Multiples characters with unique powers are available. Wanna spit a web as the spider? Grow a bamboo as a panda? Become invisible as the chameleon? Use it once per round, or collect the golden egg to use it again. Powers can also be synergized in 2v2: select the perfect team to beat your friend.

The replayability is infinite. Wanna spice things up? Play on random maps with random characters every round, or change the settings to make it super mega fun for you and your friends. For each mode numerous game settings are available!

You have an idea for the characters? Join my discord and I might add your character to the game!
